page: Vite plugin hook migration from `handleHotUpdate` to environment-aware `hotUpdate`. Deprecation: handleHotUpdate plugin hook planned deprecation favor hotUpdate Environment API aware, additional watch events (create/delete). Affected scope: Vite plugin authors. Future deprecation planned: handleHotUpdate deprecation future major, not recommend moving yet. Experiment: set future.removePluginHookHandleHotUpdate 'warn' vite config. Feedback: GitHub discussions/16358. Motivation: handleHotUpdate allows custom HMR update handling. HmrContext: file, timestamp, modules (ModuleNode array), read() (async content), server (ViteDevServer). Hook called once all environments, modules mixed Client/SSR only. Frameworks move custom environments new called-per-environment hook needed. hotUpdate hook: same way handleHotUpdate, called each environment new HotUpdateOptions instance. type ('create'|'update'|'delete'), file, timestamp, modules (EnvironmentModuleNode array current environment), read(), server. this.environment current dev environment where file update processed. modules list current environment affected. Each environment define different update strategies. Migration guide: filter narrow affected modules list accurate HMR, return empty array full reload (invalidateModule, environment.hot.send full-reload), return empty array custom HMR events (environment.hot.send custom event), client register handler import.meta.hot.on.

Migration guide filter narrow affected modules accurate HMR: handleHotUpdate({modules}) return modules.filter(condition) → hotUpdate({modules}) return modules.filter(condition). Full reload return empty array: handleHotUpdate({server, modules, timestamp}) invalidateModule per module server.moduleGraph, server.ws.send({type: 'full-reload'}) → hotUpdate({modules, timestamp}) invalidateModule per module this.environment.moduleGraph, this.environment.hot.send({type: 'full-reload'}). Custom HMR events return empty array: handleHotUpdate({server}) server.ws.send({type: 'custom', event: 'special-update', data: {}}) → hotUpdate() this.environment.hot.send({type: 'custom', event: 'special-update', data: {}}).
